## Description

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature / new tool
- [ ] i18n / translation update
- [ ] Documentation update (README, CONTRIBUTING, etc.)
- [ ] Code refactor / cleanup
- [ ] Dependency update
- [ ] Other (please describe):

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project's code style (`pnpm lint` passes)
- [ ] I have run `pnpm check` and there are no type errors
- [ ] I have tested my changes in the browser (or server for API changes)
- [ ] If I added or changed UI text, I updated the i18n messages (`messages/en.json` and other locales)
- [ ] I have updated documentation if needed (README, CONTRIBUTING, etc.)
- [ ] My changes are contained in a single commit or a clean series of commits
